python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('.claude/skills/release/SKILL.md')
s = p.read_text()

# finding 5 — the gate comment now lists four steps
s = s.replace(
"bun run check                   # biome + typecheck + README version-table guard",
"bun run check                   # biome + typecheck + README versions + cascade ranges", 1)

# finding 3 — Step 6 must stage the dependent's manifest when the cascade fired
old6 = """```sh
git add packages/<name>/package.json bun.lock CHANGELOG.md README.md
git commit -m "chore(release): <name>-v<version>"
git push origin main
```

Stage those four — `README.md` is always in the set now, since Step 4 always bumps
its version row (add `packages/<name>/README.md` too if the public surface moved)."""
s = s.replace(old6, old6, 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
